title: Artwork
description:
A complete artwork: one theme applied to an ordered list of covers
on one size.

covers.description:
Covers in priority order. One cover is a single piece; two or
more are A/B variants of the same size.

outline.description:
The cover titles of the complete artwork, in order. A preview
artwork lists more titles than it has covers: the app continues
it from this list later. Leave it empty when the artwork is
complete.

size.description: The size every cover is laid out on. Absent means thumbnail.

theme.description: Visual identity applied to every cover.

title.description: Artwork title, shown in the editor. Not rendered on a cover.

Cover.description:
One cover: an HTML fragment for the artwork's size, CSS for that
fragment, and author notes.

css.description:
CSS for this cover only. The server scopes every selector to
this cover. Use plain selectors such as `.title` or `h1`. Use
the theme through `var(--background)`, `var(--text)`,
`var(--accent)`, `var(--muted)`, `var(--heading-font)`,
`var(--body-font)`, `var(--mono-font)`. No `@import`, no
viewport units, no `<`.

html.description:
The cover as one HTML fragment. The canvas is the artwork's `size` in px: 1280 by 720 for thumbnail, 2560 by 1440 for banner, 1500 by 500 for header, 3000 by 3000 for album, 1600 by 2560 for book. Use px units. Allowed: headings, text, lists, tables, `` with `src="/uploads/{name}"`, inline `
`,
`
`, ``. Not allowed: `

notes.description:
Author notes: the title context and the alt text, as a
`Title:` line and an `Alt:` line, plus intent or handoff
remarks. Never rendered on the cover and never exported.

CoverSize.description:
The canvas a cover is laid out on. Every size is a standard
cover-art unit in px.

body.description: Family for every other text element that sets no font.

heading.description: Family for text elements with role `title` or `heading`.

accent.description: Color for highlights, shapes, and chart series that set no color.

background.description: Screen background color when a screen sets no background.

muted.description: Secondary color for captions, rules, and table stripes.

text.description: Text color when an element sets no color.

Theme.description:
Default colors and fonts that elements inherit when they omit their
own.

name.description: Theme name shown in the editor.
